fields.options:
A Monthly Close coordinates month-end work for one company and one calendar month: checklist, automated checks, exceptions, review, approval, an enforced lock and a sealed evidence packet.

It does not create a Period Closing Voucher, zero income and expense accounts or post any entry. Hard close creates or re-enables an Accounting Period owned by the close; reopening disables only that period.
